# Advisories the pip-audit gate accepts, one ID per line, exactly as pip-audit
# reports it. Read by the "Run pip-audit dependency scan" step in
# .github/workflows/test.yml and by `make security`; tests/test_pip_audit_ignores.py
# checks the file and fails once an entry's exit condition holds.
#
# Each block names the package, why the advisories cannot reach this server,
# and the condition under which the block must be deleted. A new advisory
# against the same package is NOT covered: the gate still fails on it.
#
# pillow 12.3.0: 37 advisories, published from 2026-10-16, every one fixed only
# in 13.0.0. pillow arrives solely through the optional [reranker] extra, via
# fastembed, and every fastembed release through 0.9.0 requires pillow<13, so
# no lock upgrade can reach the fix. The advisories are in image decoding, and
# no image data ever reaches PIL here: the reranker scores text pairs, and PIL
# is only imported as a side effect of importing fastembed. The Docker image
# installs no extras and ships no pillow at all.
# Exit condition: fastembed admits pillow>=13. Then delete this block and run
# `uv lock --upgrade-package fastembed --upgrade-package pillow`.
